nodes.name: Daily 08:30 IST
nodes.notes: Daily operations brief at 08:30 Asia/Kolkata (timezone set in workflow settings). Built from stored email_events state and Asana tasks, never from model memory.

nodes.name: Get Asana Tasks
nodes.notes: Fetches open Asana tasks from project REPLACE-ASANA-PROJECT-ID (verified Asana credential).

nodes.name: Get Unreported email_events
nodes.notes: Gets email_events not yet marked reported_at. Items remain unreported until the brief is successfully delivered (P2-E2E-012).

nodes.name: Build Brief
nodes.notes: Builds the brief from deterministic email_events state and Asana tasks — not model memory. Counts are code-computed; AI is not used to invent values.

nodes.name: Send Brief
nodes.notes: Delivers the operations brief to the configured owner mailbox with the connected Gmail credential.

nodes.name: Brief Sent OK?
nodes.notes: If delivery fails, items remain unreported and appear on the next retry exactly once (P2-E2E-012).

nodes.name: Any Rows To Mark?
nodes.notes: Skips Mark Reported when there are no unreported rows, so an empty day still ends cleanly.

parameters.jsCode:
const ids = $('Build Brief').item.json.event_ids || [];
return ids.map(e => ({ json: { record_id: e.id, message_id: e.message_id, reported_at: new Date().toISOString() } }));

nodes.name: Prepare Mark List
nodes.notes: Outputs one item per email_event to mark reported_at. Empty list when there were no unreported items.

nodes.name: Mark Reported
nodes.notes: Marks items reported_at ONLY after successful delivery. Processes each input item (one update per email_event).
